enchantment.abpsmod.lifesteal.desc: Melee hits heal you for part of the damage dealt.
enchantment.abpsmod.executioner.desc: More damage to enemies below 30% health.
enchantment.abpsmod.thunderstrike.desc: Melee hits sometimes call down lightning.
enchantment.abpsmod.dodge.desc: A chance to avoid an attack completely.
enchantment.abpsmod.vein_miner.desc: Mines a whole ore vein at once. Sneak to mine one block.
enchantment.abpsmod.timber.desc: Chops down a whole tree at once. Sneak to chop one log.
enchantment.abpsmod.excavator.desc: Digs 3x3 (two deep at level II). Sneak to dig one block.
enchantment.abpsmod.smelting_touch.desc: Blocks drop what they smelt into.
enchantment.abpsmod.magnetic.desc: Block drops go straight into your inventory.
enchantment.abpsmod.explosive_shot.desc: Arrows burst on impact, hurting nearby enemies (never blocks).
enchantment.abpsmod.homing.desc: Arrows curve toward the nearest enemy.
enchantment.abpsmod.leaping.desc: Jump higher and fall further before taking damage.
enchantment.abpsmod.night_owl.desc: Night vision while you're somewhere dark.
enchantment.abpsmod.second_wind.desc: Dropping below 30% health gives a burst of regeneration (2 min cooldown).
enchantment.abpsmod.soulbound.desc: You keep this item when you die.
